q: Which office conducts the periodical inspection of station accounts?
What is the written record of findings made during a station account inspection called?
Who is primarily responsible for complying with the points raised in an inspection note?
During inspection, the cash physically held is compared with which figure?
The closing stock of tickets on hand is verified against which record?
Scrutiny of a station balance sheet is mainly aimed at detecting what?
The main purpose of surprise checks of station cash is to detect what?
Surprise checks on station earnings may be conducted by which officers?
Irregularities detected during inspection must be followed up until they are what?
Test check of station earnings involves comparing what with remittances?
The parcels and luggage delivery books at a station are inspected to verify which earnings?

options.C: Correct collection of parcels and luggage charges

q: Periodical inspections differ from surprise checks mainly in that they are what?
An inspection note is authenticated by the signature of whom?
The compliance report on an inspection note is sent to which authority?

options.B: The inspecting authority or Accounts Office

q: Cash found in excess of the book balance during verification should be what?
A shortage in cash detected during verification must be made good by whom?

options.D: The person responsible for the cash

q: Verification of station remittances includes checking which supporting documents?
Test check of coaching earnings includes comparing ticket sales with what?
Test check of goods earnings includes comparing freight charged with what?
During station inspection, recovery of which charges on detained wagons is examined?
The outward parcels account is inspected to verify what?

options.A: Correct collection of freight and charges

q: Scrutiny of demurrage and wharfage registers is aimed at detecting what?
Refunds of overcharges granted at a station are verified against which records?
Station inspection includes checking the custody of which documents?

options.D: Money value books and ticket stock

q: What is the object of test check of station accounts?

options.A: To ensure correctness of earnings by examining a sample of transactions

q: Inspection notes are serially numbered mainly for what purpose?
Outstanding inspection paras are reviewed how until they are closed?
Commercial officers inspect station accounts to ensure what?

options.D: Proper collection of railway dues from users

q: Accounts officers inspect station accounts to ensure what?

options.A: Correct accountal and remittance of earnings

q: A joint inspection of station accounts may be carried out by whom?
Cash verification during inspection should be witnessed by whom?

options.C: A responsible member of the station staff

q: Inspection verifies that station remittances to the bank are made how?
A station balance sheet normally includes which items?
Inspection is expected to detect which of the following frauds?
Records of tickets sold through machines are checked during inspection to verify what?
Season ticket accounts at a station are inspected to ensure what?

options.D: Proper issue and accountal of season tickets

q: Earnings from platform tickets are verified during which activity?
Cloak room earnings are verified with reference to which documents?
Inspection of goods accounts includes verification of which lists?
Delay in remitting station earnings, when detected, is treated as what?
Follow-up of inspection notes issued to stations is the duty of which office?
At the start of an inspection, the inspecting officer should first verify what?

options.B: Compliance with the previous inspection note

q: The programme of periodical station inspections is drawn up how?

options.C: Systematically to cover stations at intervals

q: The frequency of inspection of smaller stations is determined how?

options.D: At prescribed intervals as per the inspection programme

q: Station registers and returns are checked during inspection for what?
Erasures and overwritings found in station account books are treated as what?
An inspection report should be written in what manner?
An irregularity involving suspected fraud detected during inspection should be what?

options.A: Reported promptly to the higher authority

q: Inspection includes checking the security of which station facility?
Station inspection covers earnings under which heads?
Sundry earnings of a station include which of the following?

options.C: Rent, licence fees and other miscellaneous receipts

q: Inspection checks that licences for stalls and vendors at the station are what?
Test weighment of consignments during inspection helps detect what?
Re-weighment of goods may be ordered during which activity?
Inspection points concerning another department are dealt with how?
An inspection note can be treated as closed only when what happens?

options.D: Compliance on all points is satisfactory

q: Test check of the station cash book during inspection includes verifying what?
An unexplained difference between book and physical cash is treated as what?
Inspection checks the arrangements for safe custody of cash with whom?

options.C: The Station Master and cash-handling staff

q: What is the main purpose of inspection of station accounts?

options.D: To ensure correct collection, accountal and remittance of railway dues
